items.source: Return random hash keys from the hash stored at key. If the provided count argument is positive, return a list of distinct hash keys, capped either at count or the hash size. If count is negative, the behavior changes and the command is allowed to return the same hash key multiple times. In this case, the number of returned fields is the absolute value of the specified count.
items.translation: 从存储在key处的哈希中返回随机哈希键。如果提供的count参数为正数，则返回一个不同的哈希键列表，数量最多为count或哈希大小中的较小值。如果count为负数，行为将发生变化，命令允许返回重复的哈希键。在这种情况下，返回的字段数量是指定计数的绝对值。
